column1: prodigious§Her prodigious output—four books and nine papers in a decade—came at a cost her diaries make plain.§她**惊人的**产量（十年四本书九篇论文）付出的代价，在日记里写得很清楚。§pro（在前）+ dig ← ag（说）→ 大到值得预告
prodigy§The prodigy played four concertos at nine and quit music entirely before her twentieth birthday.§这位**神童**九岁弹四首协奏曲，二十岁生日前彻底放弃了音乐。§
professional§The professional judgment was overruled by a committee whose four members had no relevant training.§这项**专业**判断被一个四名成员均无相关训练的委员会推翻。§
profitable§The line was profitable and closed anyway, because the land underneath it was worth nine times more.§这条线路**有利可图**却仍被关闭，因为底下的地皮值九倍的钱。§
profiteer§The profiteer bought four warehouses of masks in February and set the price himself in April.§这个**奸商**二月买下四仓库口罩，四月自己定了价。§
profoundly§The change affected the department profoundly and appears nowhere in the minutes of the meeting that made it.§这项改动**深刻地**影响了整个部门，却在做出决定的那次会议记录里毫无踪影。§
profundity§The profundity of the essay is easy to miss because it is written in words a nine-year-old could read.§这篇文章的**深刻**很容易被错过，因为它用的字九岁孩子都读得懂。§pro（向前）+ fund（底部，同 foundation 地基）→ 深到底
profusion§The profusion of detail conceals the fact that four central questions are never addressed.§细节的**繁多**掩盖了四个核心问题从未被触及这一事实。§pro（向前）+ fus（倒，同 confuse 混淆）→ 倾泻而出
progenitor§The progenitor of every plant in this orchard is a single tree found beside a road in 1908.§这片果园里每棵树的**始祖**，是 1908 年在路边发现的一棵树。§pro（向前）+ gen（出生，同 genus 属）
prognosis§The prognosis was given in numbers, and the four families in the room heard four different things.§**预后**是用数字给出的，而屋里的四个家庭听到了四种不同的意思。§pro（在前）+ gnos（知道，同 diagnose 诊断）
prohibit§The lease prohibits subletting, and nine of the eleven flats are sublet without anyone objecting.§租约**禁止**转租，而十一套公寓中有九套转租了，无人过问。§pro（在前）+ hibit（拿住，同 exhibit 展出）→ 事先按住
prohibitive§The cost is prohibitive for a household and trivial for the company that set it.§这笔费用对一个家庭而言**高得望而却步**，对定价的公司而言微不足道。§
proliferation§The proliferation of guidance documents—nine of them in four years—has made compliance harder rather than easier.§指导文件的**激增**——四年里出了九份——让合规变难而非变易。§pro（向前）+ prol（后代，同 proletarian 无产者）
prolific§The most prolific author in the department published forty papers and is cited for exactly one.§系里最**多产的**作者发表了四十篇论文，被引用的恰好只有一篇。§
prolong§Every extra approval prolongs a process that already takes nine months from first form to final answer.§每增加一道审批就**延长**一个从首次填表到最终答复已需九个月的流程。§pro（向前）+ long（长）
prominence§The building's prominence on the skyline was the whole argument against it, and the argument lost.§这栋楼在天际线上的**突出**正是反对它的全部理由，而这个理由输了。§pro（向前）+ min（突出，同 eminent 杰出的）
prominent§The most prominent objector had, four years earlier, proposed almost exactly the same thing.§最**显眼的**反对者四年前提出过几乎完全相同的方案。§
prompt§A single question from the floor prompted a disclosure that nine months of correspondence had not.§台下一个问题**促成**了一次披露，而九个月的往来信件都没做到。§pro（向前）+ mpt ← em（拿，同 exempt 豁免）→ 拿到前面来
promulgate§The regulation was promulgated in March and, in at least four counties, was never actually distributed to anyone.§这项规定三月**颁布**，而在至少四个郡从未真正下发到任何人手里。§pro（向前）+ mulg（挤奶／公布）
proof§The proof is four lines long and took the field ninety years to find, which is not unusual.§这个**证明**只有四行，却让整个领域找了九十年，这并不罕见。§prob（检验，同 probe 探查）
propagandist§The propagandist was better paid than the four scientists whose work he was paid to misrepresent.§这位**宣传者**的报酬高过四位科学家，而他拿钱做的正是歪曲他们的工作。§
propagate§The plant propagates from cuttings, and one specimen has produced nine hundred gardens' worth.§这种植物靠扦插**繁殖**，一株标本已产出足够九百座花园的量。§pro（向前）+ pag（固定，同 page 页／compact 紧密的）
propel§Curiosity propelled her through nine years of work that no funder would have paid for.§好奇心**推动**她完成了九年没有任何资助方肯付钱的工作。§pro（向前）+ pel（推，同 compel 强迫）
propensity§His propensity to answer questions nobody asked made his lectures four times longer than scheduled.§他回答无人提出的问题的**倾向**，让讲座比预定长了四倍。§pro（向前）+ pens（悬挂／称重，同 pendulum 摆）→ 心往那边坠
prophetic§The 1971 report reads as prophetic, and it was ignored by four successive administrations.§1971 年那份报告读来像**预言**，它被四届政府先后无视。§
propitiatory§The propitiatory gesture came too late, and the four families had already instructed lawyers.§这个**息事宁人的**姿态来得太晚，四个家庭已经委托了律师。§
propitious§The moment was propitious and nobody acted, and by autumn the opening had closed.§时机**有利**而无人行动，到秋天这个窗口就关上了。§pro（向前）+ pit ← pet（飞向，同 petition 请愿）→ 鸟飞向吉方
proponent§The chief proponent of the scheme is also the person whose department would administer it.§这个方案的主要**支持者**，同时也是将由其部门执行它的那个人。§pro（向前）+ pon（放置，同 component 部件）
propose§She proposed a compromise that both sides rejected and that four years later became the law.§她**提出**了一个双方都否决的折中方案，四年后它成了法律。§
prosaic§The explanation is prosaic: a broken lock, an open window, and nobody on duty that night.§解释很**平淡无奇**——一把坏锁、一扇开着的窗，那晚没人值班。§pros（散文，同 prose 散文）
prospect§The prospect of another nine months of hearings persuaded both sides to settle in an afternoon.§再来九个月听证的**前景**，让双方一个下午就达成了和解。§pro（向前）+ spect（看，同 inspect 检查）
prospectus§The prospectus promised four laboratories, and the building opened with one and a corridor.§这份**招股说明书**承诺四间实验室，而大楼落成时只有一间加一条走廊。§
prosperity§The prosperity was real and narrow: four streets did very well and the other forty did not.§这份**繁荣**真实而狭窄——四条街过得很好，另外四十条没有。§
prosperous§The most prosperous decade in the town's history ended the month the mine closed.§这座小镇历史上最**兴旺的**十年，在矿井关闭的那个月结束。§
protege§Her protege now runs the department and has kept, on the wall, the same four rules she taught him.§她的**门生**如今主持这个系，墙上还挂着她教他的同样四条规矩。§pro（在前）+ teg（遮盖，同 protect 保护）→ 被护着的人
protest§Nine people protested outside the office for four months, and the policy changed in the fifth.§九个人在办公室外**抗议**了四个月，政策在第五个月改了。§pro（向前）+ test（作证）→ 当众声明
provincial§The attitude is provincial in the strict sense: it assumes that what happens here happens everywhere.§这种态度严格说来是**狭隘地方性的**——它假定这里发生的事到处都在发生。§provinc（行省，同 province 省）
provocation§The provocation was minor and the response was not, and only the response reached the courts.§**挑衅**是轻微的而回应不是，而只有回应进了法庭。§pro（向前）+ voc（呼唤，同 voice 声音）
provocative§The most provocative sentence in the book is a question, and the author never answers it.§这本书里最**具挑衅性的**一句是个问题，而作者从未回答。§
provoke§The tone of the letter provoked exactly the reaction its writer had claimed, at some length, to want to avoid.§这封信的语气**激起**的，恰恰是写信人曾长篇声称想要避免的反应。§
proximity§Proximity to the railway was the site's whole advantage until the line closed in 1968.§靠近铁路的**邻近性**是这块地的全部优势，直到 1968 年线路关闭。§proxim（最近，同 approximate 接近）
prudence§Prudence would have cost four hundred pounds, and the alternative cost the company nine months.§**审慎**本会花掉四百英镑，而另一条路让公司损失了九个月。§prud ← provid（预见，同 provide 提供）
prudent§The prudent course was obvious and unpopular, and the committee chose neither of those things.§**审慎的**做法显而易见又不得人心，而委员会两样都没选。§
publicity§The publicity did more harm than the fault: nine hundred customers returned a product that worked.§这番**曝光**造成的伤害超过缺陷本身——九百名顾客退回了一件好用的产品。§public（公众）
publicize§The council publicized the consultation in a newsletter that reaches about four percent of residents.§议会通过一份覆盖约百分之四居民的通讯**宣传**了这次咨询。§
puerile§The exchange was puerile and it consumed the last forty minutes of a four-hour hearing.§这场交锋**幼稚可笑**，却吞掉了四小时听证会的最后四十分钟。§puer（男孩）
pugnacious§The most pugnacious member of the panel had, in fact, read the least of the evidence.§评审组里最**好斗的**成员，实际上读的证据最少。§pugn（打斗，同 pugilist 拳击手）
punctilious§His punctilious record-keeping is the reason the accident could be reconstructed nine years later.§他**一丝不苟的**记录，是这起事故九年后仍能被还原的原因。§punct（点，同 point 点）→ 讲究到每一点
pundit§Every pundit predicted the same outcome, and the four who predicted otherwise were not invited back.§每位**权威评论家**都预测了同样的结果，而预测不同的那四位没被再请回来。§
purify§They purify the water in four stages, and the last stage exists only to remove the taste of the third.§他们分四级**净化**水，最后一级的存在只是为了去掉第三级留下的味道。§pur（纯，同 pure 纯的）+ fy（使）
purity§The purity of the sample was ninety-nine percent, and the missing one percent explained everything.§这份样品的**纯度**是百分之九十九，而缺掉的百分之一解释了一切。§
pursue§She pursued the question for nine years, through four institutions, and finally answered it herself.§她**追寻**这个问题九年，辗转四家机构，最终自己回答了它。§pur（向前）+ su（跟随，同 sequence 序列）
purveyor§The purveyor of the story never checked it, and four newspapers repeated it within a day.§这个故事的**兜售者**从未核实它，而四家报纸一天内就转载了。§pur（向前）+ vey（看，同 view 看）→ 先看好再供货
quaint§The village looks quaint from the road and, from inside, has no shop and one bus a week.§这个村子从路上看**古雅有趣**，从里面看则没有商店、每周一班车。§
qualitative§The change is qualitative rather than quantitative: the same number of visits, doing something different.§这个变化是**质的**而非量的——同样次数的走访，做的却是不同的事。§qualit（性质，同 quality 质量）
quantify§Nobody has managed to quantify the benefit, and four attempts have produced four incompatible figures.§没人成功**量化**这项效益，四次尝试得出四个互不相容的数字。§quant（多少，同 quantity 数量）
quarantine§The quarantine lasted forty days, which is where the word comes from and why it was chosen.§这次**检疫隔离**持续四十天，词源正在于此，也正因如此才选了这个数。§
quarrelsome§The quarrelsome pair produced, between them, the best four papers the laboratory ever published.§这对**爱争吵的**搭档合力写出了实验室发表过的最好的四篇论文。§
quash§The appeal court quashed the conviction in nine minutes, and the man had served eleven years.§上诉法院九分钟就**撤销**了定罪，而那人已服刑十一年。§
quell§Four extra officers quelled a disturbance that nine of them had failed to prevent.§四名增援警员**平息**了一场九名警员未能阻止的骚动。§
querulous§His querulous letters arrived weekly for nine years and were, on four occasions, entirely correct.§他**满腹牢骚的**信九年里每周一封，其中四次完全正确。§quer（抱怨，同 quarrel 争吵）
query§A single query from a reader exposed an error that four editors had passed over.§一位读者的一个**质疑**暴露了四位编辑都放过的错误。§quaer（寻求，同 question 问题）
questionable§The methodology is questionable and the conclusion is probably right, which makes the paper hard to review.§方法论**可疑**而结论多半正确，这让这篇论文很难评审。§
quibble§He quibbled about a definition for forty minutes and never addressed the central objection.§他就一个定义**吹毛求疵**了四十分钟，始终没回应核心异议。§
quicken§Interest in the archive quickened after one broadcast, and visits rose ninefold in four weeks.§一次播出后人们对这座档案馆的兴趣**骤然增强**，四周内访问量增至九倍。§
quiescent§The volcano has been quiescent since 1911 and is monitored by four stations that have never recorded anything.§这座火山自 1911 年起**平静无事**，由四座从未记录到任何东西的监测站看着。§quiesc（安静，同 quiet 安静）
quixotic§The quixotic campaign to save the line failed four times and succeeded on the fifth.§这场**不切实际的**保线运动失败四次，第五次成功了。§Don Quixote（堂吉诃德）
quizzical§Her quizzical expression was the only response the proposal received, and it was enough.§她**带着疑惑的**表情是这项提案得到的唯一回应，而这已经够了。§
